title: steamTables operation
description: IAPWS-IF97 industrial water/steam properties. This is a propsDict operation under choupoProps (like propertyPoint), NOT a flowsheet unit. At startup it self-checks the transcribed coefficients against the release verification tables and REFUSES the run on any deviation above 1e-8. Give exactly ONE mode block per operation: point, saturation or isobar. CSV columns are canonical SI (h, u, s, cp, cv in J/kg-based units). Regions 1, 2, 3 (near-critical and supercritical, the Helmholtz form f(rho,T), reached from (p,T) by a backward density iteration) and 4 are covered; region 5 (above 1073.15 K) is refused by name. Tutorials tutorials/props/steam/steam01_if97_verification and steam03_if97_region3 lock the published verification tables (Wagner et al. 2000, Tables A3, A6, A10, A12, A29) as golden KPIs.

point.title: Single (p,T) or region-3 (rho,T) state
point.description: One state point, given as (P, T) on any region or as (rho, T) on region 3 only -- the variable its Helmholtz equation is written in; a (rho, T) that is not a single-phase region-3 state is refused by name. Reports v, rho, h, u, s, cp, cv, w and the IF97 region, printed and stored as diagnostics (psat at T rides along as a free verification pin; a region-3 state also publishes p_MPa and rho). An output { file ...; } block is optional here and writes a one-row CSV.

saturation.title: Saturation-line scan
saturation.description: Temperature scan along the saturation line: psat plus the saturated liquid/vapour pairs (v, h, s) and h_fg per row. Valid from the triple point to the critical point, 273.15-647.096 K: regions 1/2 on the line up to 623.15 K, region 3's liquid and vapour branches at psat above it (h_fg falls to zero at Tc). An output { file ...; } block is required.

isobar.title: Isobaric scan
isobar.description: h, s, v and cp versus temperature at fixed pressure. A subcritical isobar's saturation crossing is ANNOUNCED before the scan, so the h/s/v jump is expected rather than surprising. A supercritical isobar crosses regions 1, 3 and 2 continuously; region 5 is refused loudly. An output { file ...; } block is required.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — required by the `saturation` and `isobar` scans, optional for `point` (it writes a one-row CSV).
